# Walk-In Tubs 4 Less

> Online walk-in tub store, an Aging Safely Baths company (Denver, Colorado). Every tub can be bought two ways: Supply Only (tub ships by freight to the buyer; free phone tech support for the buyer or their installer) or White Glove (measure, removal and haul-away of the old tub, installation, test fill and walkthrough). Brands: ANZZI, Ella's Bubbles, Hydro Dimensions, MediTub, Rane. Prices are given by written quote; online checkout is not live yet. Phone 1-888-779-2284.

## Facts we state carefully
- Original Medicare generally does not cover walk-in tubs.
- Specs come from manufacturers' published spec sheets.
